definition: a person who plays video games a lot
description: A young man slouches on a sofa with a controller, playing a racing game on a big TV. Next a young woman sits at a desk in a dark room lit by pink and green RGB lights, hands on a glowing keyboard and mouse in front of a game on the monitor. Then a whole living room of friends leans towards the screen with controllers up, shouting. It ends in a packed esports arena where the crowd stands and cheers as a champion is shown on the giant screen above the stage.

en.question: Who is slouching on the sofa?

de.answer: Ein Gamer lümmelt auf dem Sofa.
de.question: Wer lümmelt auf dem Sofa?

es.answer: Un jugador está repantigado en el sofá.
es.question: ¿Quién está repantigado en el sofá?

fr.answer: Un joueur est avachi sur le canapé.
fr.question: Qui est avachi sur le canapé ?
